design.title: Design it
design.lede: Pick the battery, motors and props. Every number below is recalculated from this craft's own model.

checks.over-spin: {kv} KV on {cells}S spins the props far past what the motors and ESC can take: expect hot motors and a desync.
checks.weak: Thrust to weight {tw} : 1 is below the {minTW} : 1 this kind of flying needs.
checks.cannot-hover: Thrust to weight {tw} : 1 is under 1: it cannot even lift itself off the ground.
checks.hover-high: It hovers at {pct}% throttle: too little headroom to climb out or correct a gust.
checks.esc-overcurrent: Each motor pulls about {perMotor} A at full throttle, more than its {esc} A ESC is rated for.
checks.battery-overcurrent: Full throttle draws {maxA} A, more than this pack can deliver ({limit} A): it will sag and heat up.
checks.prop-clash: {span} mm props are wider than the {chord} mm between neighbouring motors: the blades would hit each other.
checks.tail-heavy: This pack sits the centre of gravity behind the mark: a tail-heavy wing stalls and is hard to recover.
checks.short-flight: Only {min} minutes of hard flying: plan short packs or a bigger battery.

design.allGood: No problems found with this combination.

tests.title: Safety tests
tests.lede: Real builds get these checks before the first flight. Run them in order: the figure enforces what each one needs.

kinds.smoke-stopper: A smoke stopper (a fuse or current-limiting lamp in the battery lead) goes between the pack and the craft for the very first power-up. If something is shorted, the lamp lights instead of the ESC burning.
kinds.motor-direction: Props off, battery in: spin each motor alone from the Motors tab and compare its direction with the frame diagram. A wrong one is reversed in the ESC configurator, never by guessing.
kinds.accel-calibration: With the craft on a level surface, calibrate the accelerometer so the self-levelling modes know which way is down.
kinds.compass-calibration: Rotate the craft through every axis until the compass calibration completes, far from steel and power cables.
kinds.airspeed-calibration: Cover the pitot tube from the wind and zero the airspeed sensor before the flight.
kinds.cg-check: Balance the airframe on your fingertips at the marked CG point: it should sit level or very slightly nose down.
kinds.elevon-check: Tilt the wing and move the sticks: each elevon must move the right way in manual and in the stabilised modes.
kinds.servo-test: Move the servo through its whole travel and check the centre, the end points and the direction.
kinds.tilt-servo-test: Move the tilt servos from hover to forward flight and back: both must reach the same angle without binding.
kinds.failsafe: Props off and armed, switch the radio off: the craft must carry out its failsafe action, not hold the last stick positions.
kinds.gps-lock: Wait for enough satellites and a good position fix before arming in a GPS mode.
kinds.arming-checks: Read the pre-arm messages: every check must pass before the autopilot lets you arm.
kinds.motor-redundancy: Stop one motor on the bench: the mixer must still hold the craft level on the remaining motors.
kinds.radio-link: Check the link quality and that every stick and switch moves the right channel.
kinds.transition: Practise the change from hover to wing-borne flight and back at a safe height.
